### Notes:
Speaker: Laura Continuing to improve taking feedback, but wanted to showcase the AU BETA Pop-Up Notification:  A notification message automatically appears on the Home Screen (visible for 5 seconds) along with an alert indicated by a bell icon in the top of the navigation bar  Appears once when the user powers on their LG TV during a 7-day flight. Shows for ~5 seconds. No hover state; purely a visual alert prompting interest. Designed to drive awareness and quick re-engagement. Panel Notification:  User can click on the message pop-up to be directed to app or navigate to the bell icon and be taken to the panel notification. The  panel notification  lives within the  Notification Center  (the bell icon). Once a user clicks the bell icon, the full panel notification appears. Lives persistently in the Notification Center for the full 7-day window. Users can navigate to it manually (one click down). Supports image + text, deeplinkable into content.
- Across H2, 13 markets deployed the Carousel Companion unit with 16:9 video, and the format consistently delivered top-tier performance across every KPI.

### Notes:
Speaker: Laura “Here’s an early look at the new Seamless Home Screen experience coming to 2026 LG TVs, with plans to push this enhancement back to older models as well. This redesign gives us a major opportunity to elevate the home screen as a premium entry point for brand storytelling. As part of this upgrade, we’re exploring a new Seamless Home Screen Ad Unit that would run alongside the Carousel. This format is built to deliver a truly immersive moment — think full-screen banner or video creative that auto-expands on hover, paired with buttery-smooth transitions that feel high-end and intentional. It’s designed to blend seamlessly into user behavior while unlocking more impactful real estate for partners. From a performance standpoint, this unit positions LG to compete directly with what other OEMs are already offering — but with the benefit of our cleaner UX and deeper household-level data. It’s a chance to drive higher engagement, richer storytelling, and incremental visibility during peak discovery moments. Before we finalize development and prioritization, we’d love your perspective. Is this a unit you’d want to test or incorporate into your FY26 planning? Your feedback will directly shape how quickly we bring this to market — and we’d be excited to build this with you.”
- Source: LG Ads 1P Campaign Data during Disney FY25 H2 (April -Sept  2025)

Speaker: Megan Turkey shows substantial growth potential: 30% of LG TVs do not have Disney+ installed, and of those that do, 70% are Lapsed users, signaling a sizable win-back and acquisition opportunity. Market investment increased from $269K (H1) to $388K (H2), with efficiency improving from $14.89 to $11.03 CPPC. The market’s strong emphasis on promoting Turkish Originals—relative to Global titles—may be contributing to performance trends and presents an opportunity to diversify creative and campaign mix.
